01-cycle-lanes.headline: Council approves protected cycle lanes for High Street
01-cycle-lanes.expected: Millbrook council approved two kilometres of protected cycle lanes on High Street after a narrow vote.

02-bridge.headline: Old Mill footbridge reopens after summer repairs
02-bridge.expected: The Old Mill footbridge reopened after fourteen weeks of repairs costing the council 410,000 pounds.

03-quote-opening.headline: Swimming pool to close for a year as roof fails safety check
03-quote-opening.kind: news that opens on a quote
03-quote-opening.expected: Millbrook Leisure Centre pool will close for about a year after its roof failed a safety inspection.

04-question-opening.headline: Bus fares to rise by 20p on most routes from January
04-question-opening.kind: news that opens on a question
04-question-opening.expected: Bus fares on most Millbrook routes will rise by 20p in January when a government fare cap ends.

05-dateline.headline: Fire crews tackle blaze at disused mill
05-dateline.kind: byline and update line before the story
05-dateline.expected: Firefighters spent the night tackling a large fire at the disused Weaver Street mill; nobody was hurt.

06-science-hedged.headline: Garden compost may cut tomato blight, small study suggests
06-science-hedged.expected: A small university study suggests garden compost may reduce tomato blight, but the results need repeating at larger scale.

07-court.headline: Former councillor denies fraud over grant payments
07-court.expected: A former Millbrook councillor denies fraud charges over community grants allegedly paid to firms he controlled.

08-sport.headline: Millbrook Rovers beat Ashford in cup replay
08-sport.expected: Millbrook Rovers beat Ashford 3-2 in an FA Trophy replay and will play Dunmore in the next round.

09-business.headline: Valley Foods profits fall as costs rise
09-business.expected: Valley Foods profits fell 18% to £42m as energy and packaging costs rose, though sales grew 6%.

10-weather.headline: Yellow warning for heavy rain across the valley
10-weather.expected: Forecasters issued a yellow warning for heavy rain across the valley on Thursday, with flooding possible near rivers.

11-explainer.headline: What we know about the new town centre car parking charges
11-explainer.expected: Millbrook town centre car parks will charge 1.20 pounds an hour from April, with the first 30 minutes free.

12-opinion.headline: Our high street needs fewer plans and more open shops
12-opinion.expected: A columnist argues Millbrook should cut business rates for small shops instead of producing more high street plans.

13-review.headline: Review: The Granary is the best new restaurant in town
13-review.expected: The Granary on Mill Lane serves excellent seasonal cooking at fair prices, though service can be slow.

14-obituary.headline: Margaret Ellis, founder of the Millbrook Food Bank, has died aged 84
14-obituary.expected: Margaret Ellis, who founded the Millbrook Food Bank in her garage in 2009, has died aged 84.

15-strike.headline: Rail staff to strike on two days next month
15-strike.expected: Rail staff will strike on 4 and 11 November in a pay dispute, with no trains expected through Millbrook.

16-schools.headline: Inspectors praise reading at Hillside Primary
16-schools.expected: Inspectors rated Hillside Primary good, praising its reading teaching after two years of improvement.

17-health.headline: Waiting times at Millbrook hospital A&E fall for third month
17-health.expected: Accident and emergency waiting times at Millbrook General fell for a third month, with 71% seen within four hours.

18-tech.headline: Millbrook startup launches solar battery for allotments
18-tech.expected: Millbrook startup Plotcell launched a 249-pound solar battery that powers allotment tools and lights for a week.

19-french.headline: Le conseil approuve de nouvelles pistes cyclables
19-french.expected: Le conseil de Millbrook a approuvé deux kilomètres de pistes cyclables protégées sur la Grand-Rue.

20-spanish.headline: La biblioteca de Millbrook ampliará su horario
20-spanish.expected: La biblioteca de Millbrook abrirá los domingos desde enero tras una revisión del servicio.
